row.notes: Reads the R&D tweakables row ('%s.%s'): minor/major/ultimate upgrade cost, cost_to_develop, num_days_to_research/develop, cost_increase_per_upgrade, research/development time and cost percentages, failure/delay chances, rush_*, dual_development_*, max_simultaneous_developments/research, secret_upgrades_viewable_level, practice_programme_points_percentage, high_inflation, research_delay_*. Callers incl. Career_Init_TeamModifiers 0x1434f9770, Career_Load_UpgradeRows 0x143539bc0. (lane owner review requested)

verify.notes: V8996 Parses the listed names but also many more (ultimate_*, rush_*, development/research/dual percentages, max_simultaneous_*). The 100.0 default (0x42c80000) is only set for four struct slots at init, not for the cost fields.
V10301 Parses cost/day tweakables for minor/major/ultimate plus rush, research, development percentages; claim lists a subset, and the 100.0 default claim is unsupported.
